assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package is a reviewable formal AI submission only for the provided provisional boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and three key areas are provisional rough polygons from the repository; they are for generation, visualization, intake self-check, and design discussion only.
assumptions.impact: All area-sensitive metrics must be recalculated after official polygons are supplied; this package does not claim official redline precision.

assumptions.statement: Land-use partition, building footprints, road centerlines, green/public space, phasing, and constraints are agent-generated concept geometry derived from the provisional site boundary.
assumptions.impact: Geometry expresses design intent and spatial logic, not surveyed parcels, approved zoning, or engineering drawings.

assumptions.statement: AI scenario cards, personas, landmarks, activities, and operation mechanisms are conceptual suggestions for professional teams to deepen.
assumptions.impact: No scenario, activity, policy, investment, or operation is represented as an approved or committed arrangement.

assumptions.statement: Global innovation ecosystem cases are high-level background references for transferable mechanisms; case facts must be verified from official sources during deepening.
assumptions.impact: Cases support mechanism design only and are not used as formal evidence for boundaries, areas, or controls.
